verdict.rationale: The README lists per-harness Getting Started instructions for Claude Code, Antigravity, Codex App/CLI, Cursor, Devin CLI, Factory Droid, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI and OpenCode, and says installation differs by harness. The skills/ directory is shared verbatim across harnesses, and ports add only a tool-mapping and bootstrap layer; release notes add Devin, Hermes, Grok and an Antigravity marketplace manifest, a community user confirms the Codex/OpenCode install path exists, and evals run the same skills in Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI. Missing for 10: the actual Cursor-specific install steps are not shown in the evidence, and the Codex/OpenCode install relies on the agent fetching an INSTALL.md rather than a native install mechanism.
